fullDescription: A cinematic, immersive digital portfolio design system featuring brutalist typography, 3D CSS transforms, and high-contrast dark mode aesthetics. It utilizes 'General Sans' for a clean, professional look and relies on bold 'massive' text sizes to create a sense of scale. Suitable for creative agencies, high-end freelancers, luxury tech brands, and architecture studios. Key features include a rotating 3D hero cube, bento-grid case studies, glassmorphism elements, and scroll-triggered background text animations. The color palette is dominated by deep black (#050505) with high-visibility neon accents (#00FF41).

structured.summary: A high-impact cinematic design system built on dark-mode principles, featuring interactive 3D elements and a blend of brutalist and minimal aesthetics. It prioritizes motion, scale, and elite positioning through typography and depth.

style.description: Typography-driven dark mode aesthetic featuring high-contrast neon accents, glassmorphism, and 3D spatial depth. Uses 'General Sans' across multiple weights (200-900) for an editorial feel.
style.prompt: Create a design system with a background color of #050505 and primary text color of #FFFFFF. Use 'General Sans' as the primary typeface. Headlines should use font-weight: 900 with tight tracking (-0.05em) and responsive font sizes (text-massive: 12vw, text-display: 10vw). Secondary text should use Zinc-400 and Zinc-500 for hierarchy. Accent colors include a signature neon lime (#00FF41) for hover states and shadows, and a cinematic gradient (linear-gradient(to right, #06B6D4, #EC4899)). Implement glassmorphism using 'background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)' with 'backdrop-filter: blur(8px)' and 'border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'. All interactive elements should have a transition-duration of 300ms to 700ms using ease-in-out or cubic-bezier curves. Navigation must use 'mix-blend-mode: difference' to ensure visibility over any background.

layout_and_structure.description: Multi-layered layout combining sticky navigation, a 3D perspective hero section, bento-grid content areas, and editorial-style pricing/footers.

prompts.prompt: Design a fixed top navigation bar with 'mix-blend-mode: difference'. Include a logo on the left with a pulse-dot animation (2s cubic-bezier pulse). Center-align menu links using 0.2em letter spacing and uppercase text. Include a right-aligned CTA button with 'bg-white', 'text-black', and 'rounded-full' styling that scales by 105% on hover.

Create a hero section with 'perspective: 2000px'. Centralize a 3D rotating cube using 'transform-style: preserve-3d' and a 20s linear infinite rotation on the X-axis. Each face of the cube should be 50vh by 50vh, featuring grayscale images that transition to color on hover. Behind the cube, place a massive background text layer ('opacity: 0.03', 'font-size: 40vw') that scales and moves vertically based on scroll position.

Construct a bento-style grid for case studies. Featured projects should span two columns with an aspect-ratio of 16:9. Smaller projects should be 1:1 or 4:3. On hover, images should zoom from scale-105 to scale-100. Implement a custom 'neon-underline' hover effect for project titles: a bottom border that grows from 0 to 100% width with a neon lime shadow (#00FF41).

Section with a dark purple glow background (#0B0216) and a large blurred radial gradient (#7C3AED, 160px blur). Tiered cards: Side cards are glassmorphic with left-side lime borders; the center 'Growth' card is white with black text, scaled 1.1x. Include an 'Investment Calculator' with a custom range input styling (white circular thumb with a lime glow shadow) that dynamically updates large text values.

Design a two-column footer. The left column features a massive headline (text-display) and social links with a horizontal line hover effect that expands from the left. The right column includes a right-aligned newsletter signup (transparent background, bottom-only border) and copyright info in Zinc-600 tracking-widest text.

special_ui_components.description: A four-faced CSS-only 3D cube showcasing different content volumes.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a 3D cube using a wrapper with 'transform-style: preserve-3d'. Define faces (front, back, top, bottom) using 'translateZ(25vh)' and 'rotateX' increments of 90 degrees. Use an @keyframes animation to rotate from 0deg to 360deg. Faces should contain centered 4xl bold text over an absolute-positioned grayscale image.

special_ui_components.description: An interactive range input with cinematic styling.
special_ui_components.prompt: Style the HTML range input by removing default appearance. The track should be #1a1a1a with 4px border-radius. The thumb (-webkit-slider-thumb) must be a 24px white circle with a 'box-shadow: 0 0 12px 2px rgba(0, 255, 65, 0.6)' to create a neon lime glow effect.
